poo_curator.text: The prize here is the Poole Logboat: an Iron Age dugout canoe about 2,200 years old, found in the harbour in 1964. It was carved from a single giant oak and is about ten metres long. Imagine paddling that out for fish.
The museum also tells of the Newfoundland trade, Poole Pottery and the harbour's smuggling. We have a very nice lifeboat too.
